Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.market

Class MarketCalendar

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.common.market.MarketCalendar
public final class MarketCalendar extends Object
The NYSE trading calendar, worked out from the exchange's rules rather than a list of dates, so it never runs out. Pure functions with no state.

Holidays: New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Washington's Birthday, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth (from 2022), Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas. A holiday on a Saturday is observed the Friday before and one on a Sunday the Monday after - except New Year's Day on a Saturday, which isn't observed (the exchange stays open on 31 December).

Early closes, at 13:00 with after-hours until 17:00: 3 July, the day after Thanksgiving and Christmas Eve, whenever each is a trading day.

Unscheduled closures (e.g. national days of mourning) are not modelled.

    • previousClose

      public static Instant previousClose(Instant instant)
      Returns the regular close that today's change is measured from: the close of the trading day before the one under way. A trading day is under way from its pre-market open until the next one's, so its after-hours, the night after and a weekend or holiday that follows all still count toward it - on a Saturday, "today" is Friday's move from Thursday's close.
      Parameters:
      instant - the instant
      Returns:
      when the previous trading day's regular session ended
